record.question: IBRD means
options: International Bank for Re-enforcement and Development
International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
record.explanation: Answer C: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development. The World Bank explicitly identifies International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD). Only the stable expansion is used, not current lending/membership numbers. Reference: https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/annual-report/world-bank?dropid=ibrd-noteworthy. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
